memory.description: Remember durable summaries in Vela's persistent state.

browser.description: Browse the user's authorized browser through Plow/Latch.
browser.benefit: I could research pages and complete browser workflows with you.

files.description: Read or write files in the user's authorized environment.
files.benefit: I could inspect and update the files you explicitly point me at.

calendar.description: Inspect or update calendars through an authorized connector.
calendar.benefit: I could check your agenda and learn repeatable meeting workflows.

mail.description: Read or send mail through an authorized connector.
mail.benefit: I could find messages and help with the mail workflows you teach me.

shell.description: Run a user-authorized command through the Plow/Latch relay.
shell.benefit: I could automate a command-line workflow after you approve it.

scheduler.description: Register an optional Hermes scheduled job for meaningful events.
scheduler.request: let me register an optional quiet Hermes schedule
scheduler.benefit: I could check an agreed routine on a schedule and stay silent when nothing changed.
